# Voice control

Say "Lens, minimise this" and more, with push-to-talk or a wake phrase. About 3 minutes.

> Needs: config.voice exists — Voice control isn't in this build yet. This lesson unlocks when it lands.

## 1. Turn on voice

**Where:** Settings › AI & Command › Voice

Push-to-talk is the default. A wake phrase is optional and always shows a mic indicator while listening. Audio stays on this PC.

## 2. Say a command

Hold the push-to-talk key and say "minimise this" or "dark mode". The recognised command appears as a chip, with Undo when it can be undone.

## 3. Ask a question

Say "Lens, how do I change the dock style?". The Guide answers and offers "Show me".

---

In Lens, open the Guide (the **?** in the top bar, or type `/guide` in Lens Command) to take this as an interactive lesson that notices each step.
